profile.headline: Frontend Engineer | Angular · React · TypeScript
profile.summary:
Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable web applications for enterprise clients in the U.S. and Mexico.

Deep expertise in Angular and React, TypeScript, and component-driven architecture. At NTT DATA, developed 
Next.js modules for SoCalGas's customer platform — delivering full Jest unit test coverage, reusable Stencil.js web 
components, and REST API integrations across remote-first teams.

My background spans the full stack: Node.js, Python, and PHP on the backend. I've also built WMS systems handling 2,000+ SKUs and engineered automated pipelines that eliminated manual order processing for e-commerce clients.

Targeting roles in San Diego / Southern California.

positions.title: Frontend Developer | Next.js Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and documented 12+ reusable Next.js modules following scalability best practices, reducing feature delivery time across teams.

- Achieved full Jest unit test coverage on all modules, improving code reliability and reducing production bugs.

- Built a cross-platform web components library using Stencil.js, enabling consistent UI across multiple product teams.

- Collaborated with backend engineers to define and implement REST API integration strategies.

positions.title: Frontend Developer | Angular Engineer
positions.description:
- Improved table performance by implementing pagination on large invoice datasets, reducing load times by ~40%.

- Developed new features for the Track & Trace and Invoices & Payments modules of CEMEX Go using Angular, serving enterprise logistics clients.

- Built payment systems enhancing UX across web and mobile platforms.

- Participated in pre-deployment reviews with tech leads, validating feature stability before release.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built WMS modules using React and Node.js, enabling purchase order processing for new warehouse clients handling 2,000+ SKUs.

- Engineered a Python-based email scraper to automate order ingestion from 4 e-commerce clients, eliminating manual processing entirely.

- Integrated PostgreSQL to support client onboarding and data management workflows.

- Trained clients and internal teams on system adoption.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built web applications supporting solar energy financing, using Angular (frontend) and PHP (backend APIs).

- Deployed full-stack solutions on a LAMP stack with shared hosting.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Managed and resolved maintenance tickets, ensuring system uptime and optimal website performance while creating dynamic web pages using WordPress.
• Designed and developed new pages utilizing Divi and Elementor themes, enhancing site functionality.
• Applied troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, maintaining system operations and improving overall website stability.
positions.insights: Skills: Hojas de estilos en cascada (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · WordPress · HTML

positions.title: Bootcamp Practician
positions.description: I worked with the Angular framework on a project focused on gamification and microlearning. My responsibilities included designing, implementing user-friendly interfaces, call APIs that enhanced engagement and improved the learning experience.

positions.title: Computer Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
I provided preventive maintenance and disinfection for computer equipment, ensuring that it was always in top working condition. 
In addition, I created a comprehensive application to manage clients, policies, computer equipment, and scheduling upcoming services using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
positions.insights: Skills: Hojas de estilos en cascada (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · HTML5 · MySQL

positions.title: Academic Advisor
positions.description:
• In charge of advising and/or teaching people over 15 years of age subjects on mathematics and Spanish at the secondary level or below.
• Also, if the occasion arises, also to alphabetize people.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: I supported existing applications while also creating new solutions to improve efficiency. One of my achievements was developing a user-friendly inventory control application for computer equipment orders using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
positions.insights: Skills: Hojas de estilos en cascada (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · MySQL · HTML

positions.description: In charge of running the Internet cafe and repairing computer equipment.
